info.name: TD SYNNEX PAC Proxy
info.description:
The TD SYNNEX PAC Proxy service allows a customer to access API requests that they otherwise may not be able to acess.

The primary API that is acessible is the Partner Center API. It also allows use of the Graph and Azure Management APIs in the context of a TD SYNNEX user.

**For more information contact:** [Msft-SE-Azure-NA@tdsynnex.com](https://mailto:Msft-SE-Azure-NA@tdsynnex.com)

---

**Note:**

- A \* by a request means it is not supported for reseller/end user access.
    
- A ^ by a request means it is not supported for CSP.
    
- A \~ by the request means it is not currently working.
    

---

**IMPORTANT:** PAC Proxy treats the PATH as case seneitive. Using the the wrong case will return a "no upstream API" error.

---

The versions of the endpoints that are show are the versions with which we tested. Other versions of the endpoints are supported.

AI Business Solutions & Security Insights Partner Support: [PXPartnerSupport@microsoft.com](https://mailto:PXPartnerSupport@microsoft.com)

---

**ASPX data is only available to TD SYNNEX and ISVs developing tools for TD SYNNEX.**

---

The Partner API for AI Business Solutions & Security Insights enables partners to integrate their existing CRM systems with Microsoft data, including usage signals, upsell propensity, incentive eligibility, referral opportunities, and other key insights.
